thread_text:
Aisha (PM): quick thread  proposal for migration commitments: policy DSL, staged ramps, and concierge tiers. looking for red flags.

Raj (Staff Architect): main tech risk = cache/kv incompat during variant switch. recommend a deterministic invalidation step and a fallback_ttl.

Mei (SRE): gating: 6h synthetic dry-run, staged ramp 5%->25%->100% over >=12h, 24h canary SLO hold. panic if error rate >3x or p95 >1.3x baseline. need runbook template.

Lina (Infra Eng): capacity requirement: preprovision_window_minutes and buffer_percent exposed. require dry-run traffic against reserved capacity before full cutover.

Priya (CS): customers demand migration dates and rollback SLA. add 72h rollback clause and audit log retention opt-in.

Leah (Sales): concierge pricing tiers look good. suggest weekend cutover priority for enterprise tier and a small onboarding fee.

Aisha (PM): minimal DSL snippet we can share:
`policy { tenant: "T-900" route_priority: [region,model_family,quant] fallback_ttl_secs: 300 }`

Raj (Staff Architect): ops must be able to pin by rollout_id. immutable rollout_id + routing_reason telemetry per request.

Mei (SRE): short ops playbook:
1) confirm reserves
2) enable DSL at 10%
3) monitor latency/errors/quality
4) rollback on panic

Aisha (PM): actions:
- Raj/Lina: DSL min grammar by EOW
- Mei: runbook + smoke tests by Wed
- Leah/Priya: customer package + pricing by Fri
- deploy-bot: create RFC stub

deploy-bot: created RFC https://redwood/team/rfc/migration-commitments :white_check_mark:

Aisha (PM): please reply with "i got it" if you own an action. :thumbsup:
